summaries.Romania: Romania faces a critical deadline today for EU recovery fund milestones while grappling with political gridlock over government formation and healthcare system failures that cost lives. The country's energy infrastructure remains vulnerable amid Russian threats, and fuel prices continue to surge despite investigations.
summaries.Healthcare: FDA approvals advance treatment options for rare blood cancers while healthcare systems scramble to implement AI tools without proper oversight infrastructure, creating patient safety risks. Medicare fraud prevention efforts intensify alongside ongoing disputes over drug pricing and cost containment models.
summaries.Tech: Apple accelerates Mac hardware releases driven by unexpected enterprise AI demand, while the broader tech sector races on AI deployment with China gaining competitive advantages in robotics and manufacturing. Major platforms face increased regulatory scrutiny on surveillance and content moderation as the industry scales automation.

items.title: Hospitals Are All In on AI, but Testing and Oversight Haven’t Caught Up
items.snippet:
A new report found that while more than 90% of health systems have deployed third-party AI tools, less than half have the infrastructure to properly test and validate them before they become embedded in patient care.
The post Hospitals Are All In on AI, but Testing and Oversight Haven’t Caught Up ap
items.line: Over 90% of health systems deploy third-party AI tools but less than half have testing infrastructure to validate safety, creating significant patient risk exposure.

items.title: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launches to study dark matter and dark energy
items.snippet: After funding struggles and a name change, the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has been successfully launched. items.title: Eli Lilly study aims to bolster case for long-term Zepbound benefits
